name: 231. Databricks ai_decide decisions (databricks-decisions)
description: The databricks provider serves the ai_decide AI Function natively on POST {workspace_url}/api/2.0/ai-functions/ai-decide. The body is Typesafe's systemone request without model, which ai_decide rejects, with options.version pinned to 1.0; the reply wraps the answers in response and names a noul value probability. ai_decide is the only model Databricks serves natively for decisions; the harness key allows only ai_decide, so the unsupported gate for other models is pinned by unit tests only. The function is text-only and reads an image part as JSON text with a 200, so an image is a local 400, and it answers a null state with no answers, so an empty input is a local 400. Fields are strict: an extra one forwarded with passthrough is Databricks' 400, and its own validation errors pass through. With convert_decision_to_responses on, ai_decide is still served natively. Each route that reaches Databricks' Decision is covered: /v1/decisions, /openai/v1/decisions and /typesafe/v1/systemone.
